data.gender_notes: Lokendar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules over the entire universe and protects it from harm, bestowing wisdom and liberation upon its inhabitants. The name Lokendar carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Lokendar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A powerful name that invokes the presence of the divine ruler of the universe, who protects and guides us on our spiritual journey towards enlightenment.
data.etymology: Lokendar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lokendar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Lokendar" holds a significant cultural presence in the Hindu tradition, evoking images of a powerful and benevolent ruler, a leader who governs all of existence with wisdom and compassion. The idea of a deity or divine being ruling over the universe is a common theme in Hindu philosophy, with gods and goddesses often being depicted as ethereal kings and queens, wielding the power to shape the world and bestow boons upon its inhabitants. The name "Lokendar" celebrates this divine kingship, reminding us of the deeper spiritual truths embedded in our cultural heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, the spiritual significance of the name "Lokendar" lies in the concept of universal sovereignty and protection. The title "Lokendar" suggests one who rules over the entire cosmos, and in doing so, safeguards the welfare of its denizens. This, in turn, mirrors the divine role of the Supreme Being, who is believed to have created and sustains the Universe, guiding its course and looking after all of its inhabitants. The name thus instills within us a sense of awe and reverence for the divine, reminding us of our connection to the cosmos and the deep spiritual underpinnings of our existence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Lokendar: The radiant one who illuminates the paths of the people in their worldly journey, guiding them towards inner wisdom and spiritual growth.
